## Validation

<!-- List commands/checks run and their result. Do not paste secrets or sensitive logs. -->

- [ ] Relevant backend tests/lint/type checks passed.
- [ ] Relevant frontend tests/lint/build passed.
- [ ] Dependency audit outcome reviewed when dependencies changed.
- [ ] Documentation links and required runbooks check passed when Markdown changed.

## Risk and operations

- [ ] No production credential, personal data, token, object key or real tenant data is included.
- [ ] Tenant/RBAC, MFA, storage privacy, Redis fail-closed behavior and audit effects were considered.
- [ ] Migration included or explicitly not needed; upgrade/rollback compatibility explained.
- [ ] Deployment, alert, retention, backup or runbook impact is documented.
- [ ] Supply-chain digest/SBOM/CVE implications are documented when image, action or dependency inputs changed.
